fragments.text: Unnecessary restriction prevents legitimate self-relayed delegations in delegateBySig
In `VotingEscrow` contract, the `delegateBySig()` function incorrectly forbids the delegatee from being the same as the transaction sender (msg.sender):
This restriction prevents legitimate delegation flows, such as when the intended delegatee relays the delegation transaction on behalf of the delegator.
By forbidding `delegatee == msg.sender`, the contract unnecessarily breaks this standard behavior and may prevent user interfaces, wallets, or delegation relayers from functioning properly.
